Name: Classy Sondra Bear
Author: Pucklebearry
Description:
18 Sondra Bear portraits for every season. Typically, I'll make a set of portraits or make an animal sprite when I'm wanting something very specific and they seem like a good place to start while learning pixel art. I usually keep these all to myself since some of them I really can't post, but these Sondra Bear Portraits have maintained my pride enough that I finally decided I wanted to share them.

These are just PNG files slapped into a folder, there is no coding I did for this so these images have to manually be switched out in Bear Family Custom NPCS > assets > portraits > Sondra

I made this so long ago, I think it was when the mod first came out and there were no portrait mods available for any of the characters, and it was made so early on that I didn't realize how old Sondra was supposed to be-- I had to retroactively go back and give her some smile lines so she didn't look like a 20 something year old! I feel like this one makes her feel like a classy beautifully aging older woman.

I've redone Sigurd about 3 times and I still haven't been satisfied with what I've come up with but Sondra just is too cute. I hope you all like this version of her as much as I do!

Downloads.Description: Some extra portraits were added to some of Sondras files in the OG Bear Family Mod, so I adjusted these ones to include the new outfit. No longer should see red in SMAPI for Sondra's Portraits not being found due to this c:
